2607.06918.title: LoCA: Spatially-Aware Low-Rank Convolutional Adaptation of Vision Foundation Models
2607.06918.paper_summary: Pre-trained Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) provide strong visual representations for diverse downstream tasks. The key challenge of VFM adaptation stems from the prohibitive costs of full fine-tuning and catastrophic forgetting. To address this, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as the prevailing paradigm for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT). However, LoRA is typically designed for transformer self-attention layers parameterized by 2D matrices. Since convolutional kernels inherently couple spatial and channel information within a 4D tensor, forcing them into a monolithic 2D matrix disrupts the inherent spatial topology. In this paper, we propose Low-Rank Convolutional Adaptation (LoCA), a convolution-aware PEFT framework that addresses spatial-channel entanglement by decoupling channel and spatial adaptation. LoCA introduces a low-rank channel adaptation for dense cross-channel mixing and refines spatial bases extracted from pre-trained kernels via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). Experimental results show that LoCA preserves pre-trained spatial priors and achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance across fine-grained classification, domain-generalized semantic segmentation, and generative benchmarks.
2607.06918.paper_summary_zh: 預訓練視覺基礎模型（VFM）為各種下游任務提供了強大的視覺表示。VFM 調整的主要挑戰來自於全面微調的高昂成本和災難性遺忘。為了解決這個問題，低秩適應（LoRA）已成為參數高效微調（PEFT）的主流範式。然而，LoRA 通常是為由 2D 矩陣參數化的Transformer自注意力層設計的。由於卷積核固有地將空間和通道信息耦合在 4D 張量中，將它們強行轉換為單一的 2D 矩陣會破壞固有的空間拓撲。在本文中，我們提出了低秩卷積適應（LoCA），這是一個考慮卷積的 PEFT 框架，通過解耦通道和空間適應來解決空間-通道纏結問題。LoCA 引入了一種低秩通道適應，用於密集的跨通道混合，並通過奇異值分解（SVD）精煉從預訓練卷積核中提取的空間基。實驗結果表明，LoCA 保留了預訓練的空間先驗，並在細粒度分類、領域泛化語義分割和生成基準測試中達到了具有競爭力或最先進的性能。
